title: Worktree Isolation
description: Root opens two git worktrees, then starts alice and bob. Same path, two contents. Codex App/CLI isolate local sessions this way; Cloud containers are s23. The teaching merge shows the deferred conflict.

steps.content: root opened wt-t1 (wt/t1) and wt-t2 (wt/t2) — not claiming, not Cloud
steps.annotation: Like two App Worktree chats. The harness picks the cwd; the model has no create_worktree tool.

steps.content: alice session → wt-t1/  (branch wt/t1) · bob session → wt-t2/  (branch wt/t2)
steps.annotation: Named branches are a teaching extra so merge has a ref. App default is detached HEAD.
write_file only writes inside wt-t1/. path.basename keeps it from escaping the worktree.
bob writes the SAME path in wt-t2/. The two files sit on disk at once; nobody clobbers anybody.

steps.content:
wt-t1/app.txt = "base
alice: design the schema
" · wt-t2/app.txt = "base
bob: write the routes
"
steps.annotation: The isolation proof: same path, different content, shared .git.

steps.content: wt/t1 merged into main · worktree wt-t1/ removed, branch deleted
steps.annotation: Teaching merge, not a Codex product exit. App would keep the checkout, Create branch, Handoff, or open a PR.

steps.content: wt/t2 CONFLICTS on app.txt — merge --abort; keep wt-t2/ + branch wt/t2 for human review
steps.annotation: The real conflict was deferred until merge. Cloud containers and PR apply are s23, not this git worktree.
